title: Automated Quarterly Business Review Preparation
problem: Account managers spend excessive hours manually aggregating data from CRM, email, and spreadsheets to build QBR decks, leading to delayed insights and burnout.
solution: Claude acts as an autonomous agent that integrates with existing data sources to synthesize performance metrics, extract key account milestones, and draft structured QBR slides for human review.
steps: Connect Claude to CRM and cloud storage repositories via authorized connectors.
Define the QBR template structure and key performance indicators (KPIs) to be tracked.
Configure Claude to extract data from the most recent quarter's closed opportunities and usage exports.
Review Claude's generated draft, verifying citations against the original source documents.
Finalize the deck for client presentation.
outcome: Account managers shift from manual data entry to high-level strategic review and client-facing preparation.
limitation: Claude may misinterpret complex data relationships if source files are inconsistently formatted; users must verify all flagged variances and citations before finalizing.
